parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
指定要操作API的环境。

- **RELEASE**: 线上
- **PRE**: 预发
- **TEST**: 测试

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi create-backend-model --backend-id 34e94fcd3e2e47a49824a89b8f92cb5e --backend-type HTTP --stage-name TEST --backend-model-data ServiceAddress_:_http://apigateway.alicloudapi.com:8080 --description model_description --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi CreateBackendModel --region cn-hangzhou --Description model_description --StageName TEST --BackendId 34e94fcd3e2e47a49824a89b8f92cb5e --BackendModelData 'ServiceAddress_:_http://apigateway.alicloudapi.com:8080' --BackendType HTTP
